Name: Standard BioTools
Description: Standard BioTools delivers the leading proteomic and multi-omic solutions that enable researchers to discover unique biological insights not accessible by other technologies.

Name: Biotage
Description: Biotage is a global partner in drug discovery, development, and analytical testing. With expertise in separation and purification technologies and a focus on intelligent workflow solutions, we help advance and protect human health.

Name: Yourgene Health
Description:
Yourgene Health offers a comprehensive suite of non-invasive prenatal testing (NIPT) solutions, including a complete NGS workflow designed to provide laboratories with flexible, scalable testing and a broad clinical menu, tailored to their needs. In addition, Yourgene provide a clinical NIPT sample service through the Manchester Genomic Service Laboratory for healthcare professionals. 

Supporting the wider reproductive lifecycle, Yourgene offer a portfolio of PCR-based clinical screening assays, including tests for cystic fibrosis, aneuploidy analysis, pregnancy loss, male factor infertility, and thrombosis risk. 

As part of the expanding Precision Medicine portfolio, the Yourgene DPYD genotyping PCR assay supports safer chemotherapy regimes, by identifying patients at risk of severe fluoropyrimidine toxicity. Early detection of DPD deficiency before starting 5-FU treatment enables clinicians to adjust chemotherapy dosing and avoid serious, potentially life-threatening adverse reactions. 

Powered by Ranger Technology, Yourgene’s portfolio of automated DNA size selection instruments delivers high-precision fragment selection and dynamic target enrichment across a wide range of clinical and research sequencing applications. Designed to support laboratories from low- to high-throughput workflows, Ranger instruments provide an innovative solution for applications including NIPT, gene synthesis, CRISPR gene editing, and long-read sequencing.  

The LightBench Discover is an automated 3-in-1 electrophoresis system combining DNA size selection, fragment length analytics, and quantification in a single benchtop solution, removing the need for multiple instruments and simplifying laboratory workflows. 

Yourgene Health is headquartered in Manchester, UK with facilities in Singapore, the US and Canada. Yourgene is part of the Novacyt group of companies.

Visit yourgenehealth.com for further information, or contact info@yourgenehealth.com

Name: Trinity Consultants - Advent Engineering
Description: ADVENT provides a wide array of services supporting the entire phase of the product lifecycle - from conceptual design through production. Our innovative consulting services cover process development and qualification, process equipment design commissioning and qualification, and GMP facility design, automation, commissioning, and qualification.

Name: Gnosis by Lesaffre
Description:
Gnosis by Lesaffre have a goal: to raise the standard of human health and build a healthier world where proactive health solutions help people live stronger, longer, happier lives.   
By diving deep into the world of microorganisms we harness the power of nature’s biological processes to create solutions that address immediate health challenges while contributing positively to human and planetary health.   
Together with nutraceutical and pharmaceutical brands we develop revolutionary products that help their customers thrive.  
Our vision is a future where health is proactive, solutions are sustainable, and every step forward is guided by the timeless wisdom of nature.   
Think like Nature to Raise human health

Name: Tessa Therapeutics Ltd
Description: Tessa Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing next-generation cell therapies for the treatment of hematological cancers and solid tumors. Tessa’s autologous CD30-CAR-T therapy TT11, is currently being investigated as a potential treatment for relapsed or refractory classical Hodgkin lymphoma as both a monotherapy (Phase 2) and combination therapy (Phase 1b). TT11 has been granted RMAT designation by the FDA and access to the PRIME scheme by European Medicine Agency. Tessa is also advancing an allogeneic “off-the-shelf” cell therapy platform targeting a broad range of cancers in which Epstein Barr Virus Specific T Cells (EBVSTs) are augmented with CD30-CAR. This platform is currently the subject of a Phase 1 clinical trial in CD30-positive lymphomas. Tessa has its global headquarters in Singapore, where the company has built a state-of-the-art, commercial cell therapy manufacturing facility. For more information on Tessa, visit www.tessacell.com.

Name: Genedata
Description:
Genedata transforms biopharma data into intelligence. Our innovative software solutions combine deep science, technology, and AI domain knowledge. Leading biopharma organizations and cutting-edge biotechs partner with Genedata to digitalize and automate complex data workflows. Our advanced analytics and embedded AI enable data-driven decisions. From early discovery through development to the clinic, Genedata solutions drive innovation and maximize ROI being trusted by customers worldwide for more than 25 years. 
 
Genedata is proud to be part of Danaher, a global life sciences and diagnostics innovator committed to accelerating the power of science and technology to improve human health.
 
As part of Danaher, Genedata is connected to a uniquely broad ecosystem of expertise, technologies, and capabilities. Together, we partner closely with customers to solve their toughest challenges with greater speed and certainty.
 
Powered by the rigor of the Danaher Business System and a culture of continuous improvement, we make time a competitive advantage for our customers and help unlock the transformative potential of science and technology to improve billions of lives every day.

Name: Euroimmun
Description:
As one of the world's leading manufacturers of medical laboratory diagnostics, Euroimmun stands for innovation. More than 3,500 employees in 150 countries develop, produce and market test systems to aid in the diagnosis of diseases, as well as software and automation solutions to perform and evaluate these tests. 
Our products are used in laboratories, hospitals, health authorities and academic institutions in over 140 countries to support diagnostics and research of autoimmune and infectious diseases, as well as allergies and genetic diseases. 

Follow us on:  
YouTube: www.youtube.com/user/EUROIMMUN 
Blog:  www.euroimmunblog.de  


Looking for amazing job opportunities?
Purpose with Impact - People who care - Perspectives for the Future. 3 good reasons to join Euroimmun.

Check out Euroimmun International Global Careers in Diagnostics: https://jobs.revvity.com/EuroimmunInternational

Name: Ecolab Life Sciences
Description:
Ecolab Life Sciences offers unparalleled cleaning and advanced contamination control expertise to pharmaceutical and personal care manufacturers across the globe. We deliver more than quality cleaning chemistry. We bring enhanced value to customers, helping optimize production performance and mitigate risk.

Enhanced value: Our expertise applied to our cleaning and advanced contamination control solutions means customers have access to a comprehensive portfolio of high-quality cleaning and disinfection chemistry, equipment, and Bioquell vaporized hydrogen peroxide decontamination.

Optimized production performance: Our expertise across a wide range of critical manufacturing applications helps customers move toward maximum production uptime and productivity.

Mitigated risk: Our expertise and global scale applied across our customers’ contamination-control operations help assist with business continuity through the worldwide availability of our solutions and knowledge of region-specific quality and regulatory requirements.

Name: Singleron Biotechnologies
Description:
Singleron Biotechnologies is an innovative life sciences tools company dedicated to applying groundbreaking high-throughput single cell analyses to clinical research, diagnostics and drug development. 500+ single-cell sequencing experts around the world are working together to translate advanced and proprietary multi-omics single-cell technologies into products that can be easily deployed in any lab and provide improved research results faster than ever before. The company was incorporated in January 2018 and currently has offices and laboratories in Germany, US, Singapore, and China.
Contact: info@singleron.bio

Name: Natac (BME: NAT)
Description:
We specialise in producing sustainable natural ingredients with proven health benefits. Our expert team conducts through research and development to deliver high-performance, top-quality solutions across diverse industries. 

Our products are upheld to a level of quality that exceeds the most rigorous standards in the industry. Plant sources are certified additionally through HABOID, a proprietary analytical method, which guarantees the purest botanical products possible.

Sustainability is integral to our business model. Natac systematically analyses agricultural processes throughout the botanical industry to discover points in production that have the potential for intervention and investment. Our goal is to use the whole plant in order to access its full potential and thereby reduce the environmental impact of production.

Internationally present with established markets around the world, Natac maintains the strategic location of our manufacturing, R&D and Innovation Unit, and Quality Department in Spain, which secures European standards.

Name: TurtleTree
Description:
At TurtleTree, we are pioneering the future of health with our breakthrough product, LF+:  the world’s first vegan lactoferrin created through cutting-edge precision fermentation technology. 

Lactoferrin, a bioactive milk protein, enhances the nutritional profile of a wide range of food and health products.  

From plant-based alternatives and traditional foods to skincare and cosmetics, LF+ provides exceptional health benefits.

Our innovative process not only contributes to human health but also ensures that animals can live carefree, happier lives. 

As we continue to push the boundaries of food science, we are seeking out partners and investors to join us as we create a healthy and sustainable future. 

Join the health revolution. Where Nutrition Meets Humanity.

Name: Guardant Health AMEA
Description: Guardant Health AMEA is a wholly owned subsidiary of Guardant Health, a leading precision oncology company focused on guarding wellness and giving every person more time free from cancer. Founded in 2012, Guardant is transforming patient care by providing critical insights into what drives disease through its advanced blood and tissue tests, real-world data and AI analytics. Guardant tests help improve outcomes across all stages of care, including screening with ShieldTM to find cancer early, monitoring for recurrence in early-stage cancer, and helping doctors select the best treatment for patients with advanced cancer.

Name: Novogene
Description:
Novogene specializes in the application of advanced molecular biotechnology and high-performance computing in the research fields of life science and human health. Established in March 2011, Novogene strives to become a global leader in providing genetic science services and technology products. Novogene has set up operations and laboratories in the United States, the United Kingdom, Netherlands, Germany, as well as in China, Singapore and Japan.

Novogene currently consists of a comprehensive, and interdisciplinary team, the majority of which hold advanced degrees from top universities in China and abroad. The company has established high-flux, large-scale gene sequencing and high-performance computing platforms, which support effectively the demands of life science research and medical health for big data analysis and storage. 

Novogene has served over 7,300 global customers, covering 90 countries and regions across 6 continents. We have cooperated extensively with many academic institutions and completed several advanced-level, international genomics research projects. By 2023, Novogene has co-published and/or been acknowledged in more than 22,850 articles in Science Citation Index, with an accumulative impact factor of more than 148,250. 

Our partners are worldwide and include more than 4,200 scientfic research institutions and universities, more than 680 hospitals and over 2,400 pharmaceutical and agricultural enterprises. Currently, Novogene has obtained 356 software copyrights and 66 patents. 

As the leader in genome sequencing, Novogene’s business spans across scientific research for life science, medical research and technology services, storage-building sequencing platform services, gene sequencing, mass spectrometry and bio-information technology support for global research, scientific research institutions, hospitals, pharmaceutical R&D enterprises and agricultural enterprises.

Name: Tissue Engineering and Regenerative Medicine International Society, Inc. (TERMIS)
Description:
ADVANCING TISSUE ENGINEERING & REGENERATIVE MEDICINE WORLDWIDE TO GENERATE KNOWLEDGE WITH A VIEW TO IMPROVING PATIENT OUTCOMES GLOBALLY

Our international community strives to achieve our mission through

    Best practice in governance
    Providing forums for dissemination of knowledge
    Interacting with diversified expertise, topics & culture
    Advancing basic, translational & clinical research
    Supporting our “Student and Young Investigator Sections” (SYIS)
    Advocating for public policies

Our core values are

Honesty; Respect; Scientific Excellence, Integrity; Collaboration; Society Responsibility; Diversity; Transparency.

Name: Lucence
Description: Lucence is a precision health company, using proprietary AI-powered liquid biopsy technology to detect cancers earlier when outcomes are better.  Headquartered in Palo Alto and Singapore, Lucence supplies personalized cancer care services through twin CLIA-licensed laboratories in the United States and Singapore. For more information, visit www.lucence.com.

Name: Romer Labs
Description:
Romer Labs is a global leader in innovative diagnostic solutions for food and feed safety. With a focus on mycotoxins, food allergens, GMOs, and microbial contaminants, we strive to meet the ever-changing demands of our customers while upholding our reputation for exceptional service.  

Innovation is at the heart of what we do. We are constantly exploring new technologies and pushing the boundaries of existing ones to simplify workflows, improve accuracy, and enhance reliability. We are committed to developing groundbreaking technology and ensuring that our products and services are always at the forefront of the industry. 

We have been providing exceptional service to our customers for over 40 years. Our dedicated technical support team is always available to provide assistance, and our technical sales team is committed to helping customers find the right solutions to meet their unique needs. In addition, we operate six analytical services labs across three continents, ensuring that our customers have access to reliable and accurate testing services whenever and wherever they may need them. 

Our core mission at Romer Labs has always been the same: Making the World's Food Safer. Through our innovative products and exceptional service, we remain dedicated to providing our customers with the tools they need to ensure the safety and quality of their products. 

Romer Labs is a company of dsm-firmenich.

Name: Hummingbird Bioscience
Description:
Hummingbird Bioscience is a precision biotherapeutics company discovering and developing transformative biologics for hard-to-treat diseases. The Hummingbird Bioscience model combines computational and systems biology, and wet lab drug discovery in a multi-disciplinary, collaborative environment spanning initial discovery through clinical development. We harness this integrated approach across target identification and patient selection, enabling our team to increase the efficiency of translating novel scientific insights while reducing the inherent risk in drug discovery and development. At Hummingbird Bioscience, our commitment to rigorous science, teamwork, and intellectual integrity underpins our passion to accelerate the journey of new drugs from concept to clinic. 

Sign up for our updates here: https://bit.ly/HMBDNews

Name: ACM Global Laboratories
Description:
ACM Global Laboratories, an affiliate of Rochester Regional Health in Rochester, New York, is a recognized leader global clinical trial testing services. ACM Global Laboratories operates in more than 65 countries around the globe, with wholly owned facilities in the U.S.A., England, India, and Singapore. Our full-time staff of laboratory experts performs more than 20 million tests annually, spanning all medical disciplines including pathology, microbiology, molecular diagnostics, toxicology and more.

For more information, visit www.ACMGlobalLab.com or call 1-866-405 0400

Name: Allozymes
Description: Allozymes is a biotechnology company redefining enzyme engineering through its proprietary ultra-high-throughput microfluidic and AI-driven screening platform. By integrating biocatalysis, enzyme discovery, and microfluidic innovation, we accelerate the development of tailored enzymes for biomanufacturing, pharma, and life sciences. With a vision to build the world’s most comprehensive enzyme data library, Allozymes is enabling faster discovery, smarter optimization, and sustainable production across industries.

Name: Probi AB
Description:
Probi is a global biotics solutions company, focused on researching, manufacturing, and delivering biotics for supplements and functional food. Founded on science, and together with customers and research partners, Probi is striving towards a future in which as many people as possible can take control of their gut microbiome - so that they can live better lives for longer. 

Born out of Lund University in Sweden in 1991, Probi has grown to serve over 40 markets worldwide and holds multiple patents globally. Since 2025, Probi has been part of Symrise AG, further strengthening innovation capabilities and global reach. 

Discover more on www.probi.com

Name: NalaGenetics
Description:
NalaGenetics was built with the passion to make preventive, DNA-based precision healthcare accessible to as many people as possible.

Specifically, catalyzed by the founders’ personal experiences of problematic medication side effects and knowledge of what genetic testing can offer, NalaGenetics aims to help people achieve better nutrition and prescription medication outcomes by analyzing their unique DNA.
 
Today, NalaGenetics’ solutions are trusted by a growing number of healthcare providers, laboratories, insurers, and corporates in Asia and Europe. We have also won government grants and mandates to carry out genomic research projects from the Government of Singapore and others.

These achievements reflect the company’s exceptional standards and depth of research as a scientist-led company, along with a commitment to delivering best-in-class genomic solutions.

Find out more about us at www.nalagenetics.com

Name: Inscripta, Inc.
Description:
Inscripta merged with Manus in April 2025 to establish a unique end-to-end platform for scalable development, biomanufacturing, and commercialization of bioalternative products.

By combining Inscripta’s advanced whole-genome engineering technologies with Manus’ proven cell factory engineering platform, biomanufacturing expertise, and commercialization capabilities, the merged company – Manus – is uniquely positioned to deliver commercial momentum and scaled profitability in next-generation industrial biotechnology.

Name: HTL Biotechnology
Description:
HTL Biotechnology is a French biotech and a world leader in the development and responsible bioproduction of pharmaceutical-grade biopolymers (Hyaluronic acid, polynucleotides). Used by healthcare companies for the development of treatments in various cutting-edge therapeutic areas such as ophthalmology, dermatology, medical aesthetics and rheumatology.

For over 30 years, HTL Biotechnology has been a driving force behind innovation in the sector, collaborating with research entities and biotech companies to address unmet medical needs (regenerative medicine, drug delivery, etc.) HTL Biotechnology recently reinforced its position as world leader in the development of pharmaceutical-grade biopolymers by acquiring, through its subsidiary HTL Biotechnology Innovation Inc (HTL BII – New Jersey), a recombinant protein platform whose most advanced product is recombinant human collagen type III (rhCOL3) within a world-class scientific research center.

To meet growing global needs for biopolymers, the company has also subsidiaries in Asia and building in the United States, a neuromodulator production unit (HTL BMI – Massachusetts). Historically based in Javené (Brittany - France), the company brings together production, innovation, research and development, as well as quality activities on its site. HTL Biotechnology employs nearly 300 people worldwide.

Our ambition is to consolidate our global leadership and create value for our customers with four priorities:

Premium positioning, by guaranteeing a high level of product quality and safety.

Innovation, by driving research in the biopolymers sector. 

International expansion, by placing production and R&D at the service of new markets and customers. 

Social responsibility, through which we aim to transform the biopolymer sector into a positive, sustainable force. 

Social media group policy: https://htlbiotech.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/charte-reseaux-sociaux.pdf

Name: Eurofins Central Laboratory
Description:
Eurofins Central Laboratory is a global organization committed to providing standardized, high-quality central laboratory services for all phases of clinical trials.

We blend the technical scale and quality standards of a large organization with the agility and personalized attention of a specialized partner. With over 25 years of experience and four fully owned, harmonized laboratory facilities located in the US, Europe, Singapore, and China, we offer one of the most extensive laboratory testing portfolios in the biopharmaceutical industry.

Our testing capabilities include integrated safety assessments, biomarker assay development and validation, exploratory and endpoint biomarker analysis, molecular testing, global flow cytometry, pathology services, and support for vaccine development.

We provide high-quality, globally harmonized data and expert scientific advice to facilitate smoother clinical trial execution and achieve superior outcomes for our clients and patients alike.

Name: Mesoblast Limited
Description:
Mesoblast (ASX:MSB; Nasdaq:MESO) is developing and commercializing allogeneic cellular medicines to treat serious and life-threatening inflammatory diseases with significant, unmet medical needs.

The Company's Phase 3 off-the-shelf mesenchymal lineage cell product candidates are:

• RYONCILTM (remestemcel-L) for steroid-refractory acute graft versus host disease (acute GVHD)
• Remestemcel-L for moderate to severe acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) due to COVID-19 infection
• REVASCOR for advanced chronic heart failure, and
• MPC-06-ID for chronic low back pain due to degenerative disc disease.

The Company’s proprietary manufacturing processes yield industrial-scale, cryopreserved, off-the-shelf, cellular medicines. These cell therapies, with defined pharmaceutical release criteria, are planned to be readily available to patients worldwide.

Mesoblast’s approach to product development is to ensure rigorous scientific investigations are performed with well-characterized cell populations in order to understand mechanisms of action for each potential indication. Extensive preclinical translational studies guide clinical trials that are structured to meet stringent safety and efficacy criteria set by international regulatory agencies. All trials are conducted under the continuing review of independent Data Safety Monitoring Boards comprised of independent medical experts and statisticians. 

Mesoblast has an extensive patent portfolio comprising approximately 1,000 patents and patent applications with protection extending through 2040 in all major markets. This intellectual property portfolio covers composition of matter, manufacturing, and therapeutic applications of mesenchymal lineage cells. The Company believes this patent estate provides strong global protection.

Name: SEQUENTIAL
Description: Sequential advances personal care and health research by studying the real-world impact of products through human clinical testing, biomarker discovery, and next-generation formulations across skin, scalp, oral, and vaginal care. Our end-to-end, in-house platform, from study design and participant recruitment (tailored to any required criteria) to laboratory analysis and data interpretation, turns complex biological data into clear, actionable insights. By combining microbial and molecular analyses, we enable the development of credible, effective, and trustworthy products and claims. With a database of over 50,000 samples, 4,000+ ingredients, and 10,000+ participants worldwide, Sequential leverages years of scientific expertise to set the standard for data-driven innovation and product validation in the personal care and pharmaceutical industries.

Name: Amoy Diagnostics
Description:
Amoy Diagnostics (AmoyDx) is a visionary diagnostic company dedicated to transforming the landscape of cancer care. 'Breaking Barriers to Precision Oncology' reflects our commitment to revolutionizing cancer diagnosis and treatment.

We are driven by four fundamental values: Innovation in Care, Accessibility and Equity, Collaboration and Partnership, and Integrity and Trust. These values guide our pursuit of developing groundbreaking diagnostic tools and fostering a more equitable, collaborative, and trustworthy approach to oncology.

Join us as we pave the way to a future where precision cancer care is a reality for every patient, everywhere.

Name: Cordlife Singapore
Description:
Listed on the Main Board of the Singapore Exchange ("SGX"), Cordlife Group Limited ("Cordlife", and together with its subsidiaries, the "Group") is presently a service provider of umbilical cord blood and cord lining banking. The first cord blood bank to be set up in Singapore (May 2001) and amongst the first in Asia, Cordlife Group Limited has more than 16 years of cord blood banking experience as well as a published track record of cord blood transplants.

The Group currently owns and operates full processing and cryopreservation storage facilities across Asia, namely in Singapore, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippines. Cordlife's processing and storage facilities in Singapore, Hong Kong and India are AABB accredited and by late 2015, the Singapore facility achieved accreditation from FACT-Netcord, placing the Group as one of the six international private cord blood banks that hold accreditations by two world-class standards. Besides being the first private cord blood bank in Southeast Asia to enjoy the dual-accreditation status, the Group also extends its products and services to families in the region through its associate in Thailand and sub-licensing partner in China.

*Conditional accreditation status for Cordlife’s facility in Singapore

Name: PharmNXT Biotech
Description:
PharmNXTBiotech, a dynamic biotech startup headquartered in Mumbai, India, was founded in 2017 with a pioneering vision – to revolutionize the bioprocess industry. Our mission is to provide comprehensive bioprocess solutions and cutting-edge technologies, all aimed at reducing the manufacturing costs of critical life-saving drugs.

A significant milestone in our journey is the establishment of PharmNXT Ekuse, a state-of-the-art manufacturing facility located in Pune. This facility specializes in the production of Single-Use products. Guided by the mantra of "Make in India for the World," we take pride in introducing our remarkable Xelta range, featuring Single-Use 2D, 3D bags, and NXTmix Levitating mixing solutions. Additionally, we offer an array of hardware technologies optimized for downstream processing of biologics.

What sets us apart is our capability to produce Single-Use consumables and equipment in-house at PharmNXT Ekuse. This strategic advantage allows us to provide holistic end-to-end solutions for biologics manufacturing. 

But our commitment doesn't stop here. At our Ekuse facility, we also specialize in manufacturing top-tier containment solutions designed to meet the stringent requirements of biologics and pharmaceutical customers. These solutions ensure high-level containment for various applications, including handling Highly Potent APIs, Reactors, Centrifuges, Granulators, Tablet compression systems, and Fluidized Bed Dryers (FBD). 

At PharmNXT Biotech, we're dedicated to setting new industry standards and continuing to innovate for a brighter, healthier future.

Name: Manus
Description: Manus is the world’s leading bioalternatives scale-up platform. We work with companies across industries and value chains to accelerate the transition to bioalternatives – better performing and more sustainable versions of complex molecules traditionally sourced from plants, animals, or fossil fuels. Our platform is proven to work across scales, bridging the Valley of Death between lab and manufacturing more efficiently and more reliably to deliver the benefits of biomanufacturing, today.

Name: Biotech Connection Singapore
Description:
Biotech Connection Singapore is part of an international network of non-profit organizations that aims to promote the transfer of ideas from theory to real world applications by providing a platform for fostering interaction between academia, industry and businesses. 

We aim to connect innovators with each other and industry resources to help you get the support necessary to conceptualize, develop and commercialize technology & research.

Our engagement with the community occurs via three ways: education, consulting and communications.

Join us today to access our global network of bio-entrepreneurs, seed funding and industry support.

Name: Automated Engineering Services, Inc.
Description:
AES (Automated Engineering Services) is a full end-to-end partner for biotech and biopharma manufacturing.

We don’t just integrate systems—we design, build, automate, manufacture, validate, and even staff entire operations from lab scale to full commercial production.

Unlike traditional integrators, AES is 100% focused on life sciences. We live this industry every day, which means we understand the science, the process, the regulations, and the urgency required to bring therapies to market.

A true end-to-end model. We support the entire facility and process lifecycle:

• Process & facility design
• Custom or configurable equipment manufacturing (OEM)
• Automation, integration & data connectivity
• Commissioning, qualification & validation (CQV)
• Staffing, consulting, and operational support

Equipment built for your process—not the other way around

We manufacture modular, configurable, and fully custom equipment across upstream, downstream, and cross-process operations. Whether it’s bioreactors, perfusion, liquid handling, filtration, TFF, chromatography, automation platforms—or something that has never existed before—we engineer solutions to fit your bioprocess, not generic standards.

We support the full spectrum of biotech and biomanufacturing, including:

• Cell Therapy
• Gene Therapy
• Antibodies & Recombinant Proteins
• Vaccine Production
• CMO / CDMO Operations
• Cultured Foods / Alternative Proteins
• Industrial Biotechnology

Global reach. Fast deployment. Real execution.

Our worldwide footprint and mobility infrastructure allow us to mobilize teams quickly—with permits, visas, and site access fast-tracked—so projects don’t stall.

Why AES?
Because we build more than equipment.
We build the ecosystem that makes manufacturing work—efficiently, compliantly, and at scale.

AES is where engineering, equipment, and innovation converge to bring bioprocesses to life

Name: CellAgri
Description:
CellAgri is a news and insights platform that explores the future of food with cellular agriculture. We share the latest news and updates relating to the ever-changing field of cellular agriculture, from the latest updates to the growing number of companies around the world.

We offer a number of resources to help visitors learn more about cellular agriculture and how it can help us develop a sustainable food system for the future, from events to the first eBook about cellular agriculture. CellAgri's platform also tracks and promotes all the major and upcoming players in the field. Providing them the ability to post and share their latest news and job openings.

Ultimately, we aim to promote a dialogue about this emerging field as a future alternative to the present livestock agricultural system.

Name: NovogeneAIT Genomics
Description:
NovogeneAIT Genomics, headquartered in Singapore, is a premier provider of multi-omics services and solutions. Established in 2016 through a strategic joint venture between Novogene and AITbiotech, we have grown to be one of the largest NGS service providers in Southeast Asia.

Our unwavering commitment to delivering high-quality, efficient, and cost-effective omics solutions has propelled us to the forefront of genomic research. NovogeneAIT Genomics offers an extensive range of multi-omics services, including genomics, transcriptomics, single-cell/spatial transcriptomics, metagenomics, and proteomics. Operating from our cutting-edge sequencing center in Singapore, we are dedicated to advancing scientific research by providing superior data quality.

For more information, visit www.novogene.com/amea-en/

Name: SyAqua
Description:
Founded in 2001, SyAqua Group, cemented its position as a strong emerging player in commercial shrimp genetics market. Further solidifying SyAqua’s market presence was the acquisition by Gold Coin in 2011 as an independent entity for Gold Coin's hatchery feed operations. In 2022, Ocean 14 Capital obtained a majority share, marking a significant turning point in SyAqua's trajectory to pioneer sustainable shrimp technologies in both genetics and nutritional feed.

SyAqua Genetics division has gained significant traction in major Global markets, such as USA, China, India, Indonesia, Thailand, and Malaysia. SyAqua's renowned Balanced Line genetics, is a combination of robustness, higher survival rate, and excellent growth, has excelled across diverse production environments and management systems in Asia.  To maintain a competitive edge, SyAqua continues to consistently invest in cutting-edge genetics research and industry experts to ensure a consistent delivery of improved performance.

Recently, SyAqua Nutrition inaugurated a state-of-the-art hatchery feed plant, equipped with best-in-class technology, to broaden its range of feeds, thereby fortifying its presence in pivotal markets. This strategic move aims to strengthen SyAqua's position as a major player in hatchery solutions and a leading provider of high-quality early nutrition for shrimp.

SyAqua’s robust presence in key markets, is grounded through successful long-term customer relationships accompanied by unrivalled customer service. With a combined management team with over 200 years of collective experience in aquaculture, nutrition, and genetic solutions, SyAqua, dedicates this wealth of expertise to support the thriving success of hatcheries and farms, globally . 

Together with O14C, SyAqua will pioneer the shrimp industry, creating sustainable shrimp technologies, addressing the needs of shrimp farming today, and ensuring sustainable food security for tomorrow.
www.facebook.com/profile.php

Name: A*STAR Institute of Molecular and Cell Biology (A*STAR IMCB)
Description: The Institute of Molecular and Cell Biology (IMCB) is a premier research institute at A*STAR whose mission is to harness biology for transformational bio-therapeutics and diagnostics. With a strong emphasis on collaboration with stakeholders across the ecosystem in Singapore, IMCB aims to achieve scientific excellence and continues to nurture the next generation of scientists in order to create growth and enhance lives.

Name: Nanyang Biologics
Description: At Nanyang Biologics, we are driven by a singular mission: to extend healthy human longevity through the discovery of transformative therapeutics rooted in nature. Name: ClinActis
Description:
ClinActis is a leading full-service contract research organization (CRO) providing clinical trial services in the Asia Pacific region to pharmaceutical, medical device, medical nutrition, and biotech companies. Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore, our management and operational teams have more than 50 cumulative years of experience in clinical research.

We take pride in being one of the key players in clinical trials in Asia. Our experienced team of professionals has extensive experience working on global clinical trials, as well as a deep understanding of the local cultures, regulations, and healthcare systems in the APAC region. This enables us to deliver customized clinical trial solutions that address the unique needs of our clients and the specific requirements of each country in the region.

As a full-service CRO, we offer a comprehensive range of services and solutions, including study design, protocol development, site selection, project management, data management, biostatistics, medical writing, and regulatory affairs. Our goal is to provide our clients with a seamless and efficient clinical trial experience in Asia Pacific, from start to finish.

At ClinActis, we are dedicated to helping our clients bring safe and effective drugs and interventions to the market. Contact us today to learn more about how we can support your clinical research needs in the Asia Pacific region.

Name: Entobel
Description:
Entobel is converting low value organic substrate into high quality products thanks to insects. 

Our main current products are sustainable animal feed (proteins and oils) and organic fertilizer. 

Since 2013, Entobel is running a commercial scale production site in Vietnam and exporting products worldwide. 

Entobel complies with highest standards in the industry (ISO 22000), only use tracable feedstocks and is FDA approved. 

Entobel is looking for strong partners to join for its expansion plans. Don't hesitate to contact us for more information.

Name: ACT Genomics
Description:
ACT Genomics is a world-leading genomic test solution provider. Our mission is to make personalized medicine accessible to all. 

We offer precision medicine services globally. Combining tumor biology, cancer genomics, and bioinformatics experts to provide treatment guidelines for solid tumors, relapse, and drug resistance, as well as cancer monitoring, risk assessment, and immunotherapy evaluation. We are dedicated to turning every cancer patient's genetic information into actionable resolutions through cutting-edge next-generation sequencing (NGS) platforms, bioinformatics analysis, and comprehensive service offerings.

Our NGS platform, coupled with sophisticated bioinformatics tools and curated proprietary databases, enables us to deliver reliable results for clinical and research purposes, and our data visualization technologies make the scientific results easily understandable for everyone. 

Our clinical services include cancer prevention, early detection, treatment selection, and disease monitoring. Our genomic assays offer comprehensive cancer genomic profiling and treatment options for patients with cancer and provide insights into biomarker discovery and patient stratification for clinical trials.

Name: Curiox Biosystems
Description:
Curiox Biosystems is revolutionizing the field of suspension cell sample preparation with innovative technologies that address some of the biggest challenges in research and clinical diagnostics. Our groundbreaking Laminar WashTM technology and C-FreeTM platform set new standards for efficiency, precision, and ease, making us the most exciting company in the suspension cell sample prep space today.

The Laminar WashTM system is designed to improve the quality of cell preparation by eliminating the traditional centrifugation steps that can disrupt cell integrity. This approach not only saves time but also enhances sample viability and consistency, leading to more accurate and reproducible results. Our C-FreeTM platform takes automation to a new level, delivering customized, hands-free solutions that enable labs to streamline processes and maintain complete control over sample handling. By removing manual steps, C-FreeTM offers unprecedented precision in cell prep, helping researchers achieve cleaner data with greater efficiency.

In 2023, Curiox Biosystems marked a major milestone by going public on the KOSDAQ exchange in Korea, a testament to our growth, innovation, and industry impact. This achievement has fueled our momentum as we expand both in personnel and technology, adding talent and resources to support our vision of transforming life sciences. With a growing portfolio of solutions and a talented team dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what’s possible, Curiox Biosystems is a company to watch.

Name: Dovoy
Description:
Dovoy is a biotechnology company providing speciality enzymes, novel yeast based solutions and industrial additives for textile, grain processing, animal health, and food processing industries

Our ISO 17025:2017 certified advanced laboratories enable the development of customized solutions that address the dynamic needs of the industries along with improving efficiency and performance 

Headquartered in Singapore with offices in India and China, we have  operations across Asia, Africa and Middle East

Name: Gold Standard Diagnostics Industrial Solutions
Description:
Gold Standard Diagnostics is a global provider of diagnostic test kits, lab consumables and automation solutions in the fields of bioanalytical testing for the food, feed, environmental, biopharma, animal health, and clinical industries. We are engaged in the innovative development, quality manufacturing, and the outstanding commercialization of our solutions. 
Our company aims to become an innovative and trusted solution provider for all our stakeholders, and strives to simplify and improve customer experience.

Name: AMILI
Description:
AMILI is the #1 precision gut microbiome company in Asia, based in Singapore.

We host Southeast Asia's first and only gut microbiome transplant bank and the world's largest multi-ethnic Asian gut microbiome database, forming the foundation of personalised microbiome science for Asian populations.

We put this to work across the full spectrum of gut health, supporting patients and clinicians from insight through to intervention. Our gut health test delivers precision insights into microbiome abundance, functionality, and its impact on health. 

From there, care can be tailored through targeted probiotic formulations, AMILI Optimise, our metabolic program built around diet, nutrition, and lifestyle, or Microbiome Restoration Therapy for more complex clinical presentations.

This clinical work sits alongside an active research and partnerships programme spanning microbiome science and functional foods, all oriented toward a single goal: advancing how human health is understood and managed, starting from the gut.

Name: STOmics
Description:
STOmics is a platform that develops tools for life science, biotechnology, and healthcare applications. It specializes in creating innovative solutions for spatial multi-omics. The company has commercialized the Stereo-seq solution, which is now available in the market. 
STOmics Stereo-seq is the only spatial multi-omics solution available worldwide that can access the entire transcriptome at true single-cell resolution. With subcellular data achieved through Ultra-HD resolution, this solution provides field-of-view options over 160 square cm.
Since its release in early 2022, it has drawn extensive attention worldwide, ushering in the third revolution in the field of life science and leading life sciences research into a new era.

Name: Cordlife Group Limited
Description: Cordlife owns the largest network of cord blood banks in Asia with full stem cell banking facilities in six key markets, namely Singapore, Hong Kong, Indonesia, India, Malaysia and the Philippines. In Singapore, Hong Kong, the Philippines and Indonesia, Cordlife operates the largest private cord blood banks and it is amongst the top three market leaders in India and Malaysia. In January 2018, Cordlife became the market leader in Hong Kong with the acquisition of the largest private cord blood bank, Healthbaby Biotech (Hong Kong) Co., Limited. Through its majority-owned subsidiary in Malaysia, Stemlife Berhad, Cordlife holds an indirect stake in Thailand's largest private cord blood bank, Thai Stemlife. Cordlife has also established its presence in Myanmar, Vietnam, Macau, Brunei and Bangladesh.

Name: Cerecin
Description:
Cerecin is a global healthcare company with more than 20 years of innovation and leadership in brain health.

At Cerecin we think differently. We develop novel evidence-based solutions that help people; pharmaceuticals, medical foods, diagnostics, medical devices and e-health products. These solutions target conditions ranging from memory impairment to some of the most devastating neurological diseases.

Name: Celero
Description:
Celero’s Vision: Reducing the barriers to market entry for Biotechs while addressing the unmet needs in emerging Asia and Africa.

Our mission is to achieve this vision by providing our Biotech partners with the highest quality, efficient and accelerated clinical trials in Emerging Asia and Africa, ultimately resulting in optimal returns on their investments. 

This endeavor will be propelled by our experienced clinical research team, leveraging local expertise, access to diverse populations, and forthcoming innovative digital solutions. 
Additionally, our clinical trial solutions will be fortified by the implementation of registration, commercial, and local manufacturing strategies meticulously tailored to the specific needs of our Biotech partners.
With 285 years of unparalleled expertise, our senior management team boasts 182 years in Clinical Operations, Site Management, Medical & Regulatory Affairs, and 103 years in Commercial, Pharma & Vaccines Manufacturing, and Clinical Finance. Our team has successfully completed 80 clinical trials, including 64 for vaccines, resulting in over 20 product approvals. 
We are dedicated to being a key contributor to the financial success of our sponsors' products by providing them market access to high commercial growth potential markets. 

If you believe your pipeline products are innovative, possess favorable efficacy and safety profiles, and have clear clinical differentiators, we want to talk. 

Contact us by visiting our website at www.celero.global or reaching out to us at info@celero.global.

Name: Engine Biosciences
Description:
Engine Biosciences is a venture-backed San Francisco- and Asia-based technology company pioneering network biomedicine. Our proprietary and patented technologies oriented around deciphering the complexity of biology networks include both high-throughput wet lab experimentation and artificial intelligence algorithms for drug discovery and cellular reprogramming. This platform, developed through several years of research by our scientific founding and leadership team who include faculty members at MIT, Harvard, Mayo Clinic, and UCSD, dramatically accelerates and reduces costs of the R&D process for new medical therapies.  We are actively applying the platform internally and with partners across a range of disease indications.

In January 2018, we announced the closing of a US$10M seed round from notable biotech and tech institutional investors and are expanding the team.

Name: SciMed Asia
Description:
SciMed (Asia) is a leading provider of innovative and exceptional solutions responding to customer needs for innovation and to drive and enhance their competitive edge. 
 
With almost 30 years of market experience, we empowered customers with unmatched portfolio of products and services from renowned group of manufacturers such as STERIS, PHCbi, Tecan, Baker, Infors, Gilson, Corning, and many more.

Name: Expecto Health Science
Description: Expecto Health Science (Southern Star Research Company) is a leading Clinical Research Organization headquartered in Singapore, specializing in delivering comprehensive and cost-effective services throughout the Asia Pacific region. Description:
Welcome to ScaleUp Bio’s LinkedIn channel!
 
ScaleUp Bio is a Singapore-based CDMO specializing in precision fermentation for food, nutrition, and specialty bio-based ingredients. Description:

Name: SAN Group
Description:
SAN Group is a globally operating biotechnology company headquartered in Austria with employees on four continents. Name: Carmine Therapeutics
Description:
Carmine Therapeutics, headquartered in Cambridge MA, is pioneering a new class of non-viral gene therapies based on red blood cell extracellular vesicles, combined with proprietary payloads. In June 2020, Carmine inked a research alliance with Takeda Pharmaceuticals worth up to $900 million to develop non-viral gene therapies for 2 targets. Carmine has also been named one of the FierceBiotech’s Fierce 15 Biotech companies of 2020 and was also awarded the Bristol-Myers Squibb "Golden Ticket". Carmine was founded in 2019 by EVX Ventures, Professors Harvey Lodish (Whitehead, MIT), Minh Le and Jiahai Shi. Professor Lodish, who was a founding member of several successful biotech companies that include Genzyme and Millennium Pharmaceuticals, is also Chair of the Scientific Advisory Board of Carmine.
 
For more information, visit www.carminetherapeutics.com

Description: EVX Ventures is a global investor focused on the life sciences and healthcare sectors. Our mission is to invest in life sciences ventures and support their growth, creating lasting impact worldwide. We are dedicated to backing visionary entrepreneurs and transformative technologies to propel them to success.

Name: Nucleic Acid Therapeutics Initiative (NATi)
Description:
The Nucleic Acid Therapeutics Initiative (NATi) is a national platform that aims to build Singapore into a regional hub for nucleic acid therapeutics (NAT) research, clinical translation, and commercialisation.

NATi harnesses the potential of nucleic acids to treat diseases using RNA molecules. This initiative bolsters strategic partnerships and propels healthcare innovations, benefitting Singapore and Singaporeans.

Name: Galatek Life Sciences
Description:
Galatek designs and delivers intelligent automation solutions that align with how science and industry actually operate. 

We offer tiered portfolios of automation - from standalone instruments to targeted, workflow-specific solutions, and fully integrated systems. Our platforms scale over time and can be customized for unique scientific and operational needs, enabling organizations to modernize at their own pace without unnecessary complexity or disruption. 

Across life sciences, applied chemistry, semiconductors, and sustainable energy, Galatek focuses on workflows where precision, reproducibility, and data integrity matter most. By combining AI, robotics, software, and domain expertise, we help customers reduce manual variability, increase throughput, and generate data they can trust - whether improving a single process or coordinating multi-step workflows. 

Headquartered in Singapore, with R&D, delivery, and service teams across the US, Europe, Japan, and Southeast Asia, Galatek pairs global scale with strong local execution. We work closely with customers from design through deployment, and ongoing support, ensuring solutions meet regulatory, technical, and operational requirements. 

Galatek partners with organizations that value flexibility over rigidity, collaboration over transactions, and progress that is scalable, sustainable, and grounded in scientific rigor.

Name: ImmunoScape
Description: ImmunoScape is transforming cancer therapy with its novel Seed-and-Boost approach, which combines our proprietary optimised TCR T cells with clinically-validated Immuno-STAT T cell engagers. This pioneering approach addresses the shortcomings of current cell therapies by enabling potent in vivo expansion of infused tumor targeting T-cells. Our combination therapy has the potential to transform cell therapy, through the delivery of safe, tolerable and effective therapies against cancer while simplifying the patient journey. We are currently advancing IND-enabling studies and accelerating entry into the clinic.

Name: Insect Feed Technologies
Description:
We farm black soldier flies as a reliable, cost-effective and sustainable source of protein to feed animals.

Insect farming is an emerging practice, where waste is fed directly to insects. This converts low value biomass into higher value insect mass, rich in proteins, fats and chitin. Insects can then be used as sustainable inputs for a variety of sectors, most notably high quality animal feeds demanded by the aquaculture sector & premium pet food markets.

We partner with various food manufacturing companies to dispose their food waste. If you have a food manufacturing facility or have a constant food waste stream that requires disposal, do reach out to us below.

Name: Yokogawa Insilico Biotechnology GmbH
Description: Yokogawa Insilico Biotechnology GmbH delivers predictive Digital Twins for the biopharmaceutical industry. Insilico Digital Twins lead to superior productivity, product quality and process robustness by using artificial intelligence and mechanistic knowledge. As a result, Insilico's unique approach substantially reduces costs of manufacturing and time to market. Leading biopharmaceutical companies worldwide use Insilico Digital Twins for process development and manufacturing of drugs. Founded in 2001, Insilico Biotechnology is a privately held company based in Stuttgart, Germany.

Name: GangaGen Biotechnologies
Description: GangaGen, is a biotechnology company focused on the development of products for the prevention and treatment of bacterial infections, particularly infections that are resistant to antibiotics, through the application of contemporary molecular and clinical sciences. The Company's technology has arisen from its studies of bacteriophage and bacteriocins, nature’s antibiotics.

Name: Allay Therapeutics
Description:
Allay Therapeutics is pioneering ultra-sustained analgesic products to transform post-surgical pain management and recuperation for patients and physicians. 

We believe an era of stalled innovation for pain management is over. From San Francisco to Singapore, our team has a passion for solving medical challenges that could benefit millions. We pursue our mission with the energy of a dynamic, global team of entrepreneurs, scientists, clinicians and innovators.

Name: Etcembly Ltd
Description:
Etcembly is pioneering a new frontier in immune repertoire analysis, where cutting-edge computational technologies converge with the transformative power of large language models (LLMs). Our mission is to redefine the landscape of immune system research, offering innovative tools and solutions that deepen the understanding of immune responses, ultimately paving the way for next-generation immunotherapies.

Our proprietary platform, EMLyTM seamlessly integrates the massive data-processing power of LLMs with cutting-edge immune repertoire analysis techniques. Paired with the EMLyTM Co-pilot provides a range of in silico engineering and optimization tools via an intuitive, digital scientist interface, we can streamline discovery and engineering to just minutes. Transforming what once took months into rapid, high-confidence insights, giving researchers and clinicians the power to identify novel biomarkers, accurately predict therapeutic outcomes, and craft potent treatment strategies.

Through our relentless commitment to innovation and excellence, Etcembly is leading the charge in next-generation immunotherapy, with the ultimate goal of transforming patient care.

Name: Ecolex Animal Nutrition
Description:
Founded in 2005, Ecolex Animal Nutrition is a global leader in innovative animal nutrition, with expertise embedded in molecular engineering and bioscience. We are dedicated to developing sustainable solutions that enhance productivity while minimizing environmental impact.

Ecolex has built a strong reputation as a leading manufacturer and supplier of specialty rumen bypass and rumen inert fats for the global dairy farming industry. From our state-of-the-art production facility near Port Klang, Malaysia, we supply to more than 35 countries across five continents — bringing science-backed nutrition solutions to farms and feed mills worldwide.

Guided by the One Health philosophy, we believe that animal health, human wellbeing, and planetary sustainability are inseparable. Our four pillars — Functional Lipids, Performance Solutions, Health & Environment, and Alternative Ingredients — serve a broad range of species including dairy and beef cattle, poultry, swine, aquaculture, and companion animals.

Name: One Science Pte. Ltd.
Description: One Science is a startup company with innovative online marketplace that provides access to high-quality laboratory supplies for scientists, researchers, and businesses. Founded with a mission to make the process of purchasing laboratory supplies easier and more efficient, One Science offers a wide range of products from trusted brands at competitive prices. The platform provides an intuitive and user-friendly experience, making it simple for customers to find and order the products they need. One Science is dedicated to supporting scientific progress by delivering reliable, high-quality laboratory supplies to customers around the world.

Name: BioChromatographix International
Description: BCI is a Singapore-based biotechnology company specializing in the development and manufacturing of Next-Generation Monolithic Media for pharmaceutical purification. With a focus on performance, scalability, and material innovation, BCI is enabling the next wave of Cell and Gene Therapy manufacturing through advanced flow architecture and industry-leading purification efficiency.

Name: 7 Trinity Biotech Pte Ltd
Description:
7 Trinity Biotech serves as an incubator that leverages the latest advancements in biotechnology, science and medicine to create more effective solutions to humanity's greatest health problems. 

We exist at the intersection of biotechnology and nature with a single minded goal of developing a healthier tomorrow, today. 

To date, we have addressed chronic dehydration amongst pregnant and breastfeeding women with Aquamamma, a daily hydration solution with additional folic acid and vitamins. We are soon launching a completely natural solution to the global mental health crisis called aurum+, a mycolicibacteria that’s been clinically proven to increase resilience to stress and treat anxiety and stress-related mental health conditions.

When our ‘ideas’ or solutions show great promise, we test and validate them to the point of commercialisation - making sure that they will create a positive impact globally for both humanity and our environment. If they pass our strict validation process we spin them off into stand-alone companies and help them grow to become a global success.

Name: BioBeers (Singapore)
Description: Biobeers is a regular coming together of the biotech community in Singapore. We talk, we drink, we share ideas and let the connections happen. Established in early 2000s, this event has stood witness to several milestones in Singapore biotech. We bring together researchers, scientists, academicians, biotech professionals, investors and anybody looking to exchange ideas and foster friendships over a drink or two

Our location in Singapore enables us to increase the level of service to our customers residing in Singapore, and neighbouring countries in South-east Asia.

Description: Zero2.5 Biotech Pte Ltd is a provider of smart IoT products and services for delivering clean and fresh air. We focus on applying ground breaking bio-technology solutions to address air quality problems in the home, in enterprise or in healthcare.

Description: Established in Singapore since 2006, AITbiotech Pte Ltd is an ISO 13485 certified biotechnology company that develop, manufacture and supply Singapore-branded molecular diagnostic and genomic products for the international market.  Its products are now sold in more than a dozen Asian countries. Apart from having a core team of experienced biotechnologists for in-house development, AITbiotech also works very closely with local scientific and medical experts such as A*STAR and NUS. AITbiotech is the first Southeast Asian Company to commercialize multiplex real-time PCR assays under the brand abTESTM for the detection of pathogens such as Influenza, Dengue, Chikungunya, Zika and Malaria. Name: Austrianova
Description:
Austrianova encapsulates living cells in tiny cellulose beads. The beads act as a microenvironment for living cells, allowing them to be metabolically active and divide, whilst being protected from the environment both in vivo (immunoprotection) and in vitro (sheer force, freezing stress protection). 

Cell-in-a-Box enables allogenic or xenogenic mammalian cells to be protected from rejection by the immune system, but their porous nature allows therapeutic bioproducts to be released and encapsulated cells to survive for long periods. Cell-in-a-Box has many advantages e.g. 1) clinically proven safety and efficacy upon implantation of encapsulated cells in patients 2) cells can grow within the capsules in bioreactors and are thus protected from shear forces - especially useful for fragile cells such as stem cells 3) freezing and storage of encapsulated mammalian cells at -80C for more than 5 years and then revival with greater than 90% viability, thus cells can be easily transported on dry ice.

Bac-in-a-Box enables probiotic bacteria and yeast to be encapsulated to protect them from harsh environments. Bac-in-a-Box has a number of advantages e.g. 1) it is based on a natural polymer which is digestible 2) it totally protects probiotics from low pH as found in the stomach for extended periods (hours), allowing almost 100% of ingested probiotic cells to reach and be released in the lower intestine 3) it allows freeze drying of probiotics without appreciable loss of viability so they can be easily stored and transported at room temperature.

We offer cell encapsulation R&D and cGMP production for both
 - mammalian cells (stem cells, engineered cell lines etc) all the way from the lab to clinical trial material (Cell-in-a-Box) and for
- bacteria and yeast encapsulation for excellent long term storage at ambient temperatures as well as 5 to 7 logs better protection from acid degradation in the stomach and later release in the large intestine (Bac-in-a-Box).

Description:
According to the World Health Organization and the Center for Disease Control, our indoor space is substantially more polluted than the outdoors. Therefore, the pollution in the air rapidly descends onto the surfaces below. The result is that, on average, surfaces and objects hold more than 5x the amount of pollution than that of the air. living micro-organism such as mold and bacteria depend on contaminated surfaces/objects to provide for their food as it may be only consumed when everybody is on solid objects. Therefore, abundance of pathogens find refuge on surfaces and objects where they continue to prosper and grow.  The outcome is that physical contact with surfaces and objects is responsible for more than 80% of infectious disease transmissions.
None of the air purifiers in the market today, offer a safe and efficient solution; The method of a filtering device is to sack air into a cleaning chamber where it is treated by UV light beams or a physical barrier such as an active filter, that is well designed, may block a substantial portion of the particles in the air. NexaLab’s technology emphasizes minimal carryover, low reagent consumption, and gentle handling of sensitive biomolecules, making it particularly suitable for workflows involving expensive proteins, antibodies, enzymes, and gene-editing reagents.
